subject.title: fix(agents): treat codex exec_command as exec-like

question: Should maintainers require live Codex app-server proof before treating this PR as merge-ready?
rationale: The source-level bug and fix shape are clear, but the exact reported producer path is still unproven and the contributor proof is only tests plus Codex source inspection.

options.title: Require live proof
options.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or a recording showing the read-only and mutating `exec_command` cases after the patch.

options.title: Accept source-contract proof
options.body: Maintainers can explicitly accept the Codex source contract and focused OpenClaw tests despite the missing live app-server turn.

options.title: Pause or replace
options.body: If live or producer-path proof is not forthcoming, pause this PR and keep the linked issue open for a proven replacement fix.

recommendation.title: Require live proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted terminal output, logs, copied live output, linked artifact, or a recording showing the read-only and mutating `exec_command` cases after the patch.

likelyOwner.reason: The current helper and mutation lines blame to recent area work by this person, and the risk is in shared agent warning/mutation behavior.
